The diagnostic equipment signals the following error: "C1315 Slewing sensor"

this error is signalled if the sensor voltage is < 0.3 V or > 4.7 V or if the value sent by the sensor is not plausible. This means that there is an open circuit or short circuit (positive or earth) for the sensor or the wiring, that the sensor is mechanically damaged or that the reading circuit is damaged

1

SENSOR COMPATIBILITY CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check the design number for the slewing sensor is compatible with the part number for the Model-Version-Series in question

Move on to Step 2

The design number is not compatible

Replace the slewing sensor with one that is compatible for the Model-Version-Series

Op. 3350E30 LATERAL ACCELERATION AND YAW SENSOR R R

Move on to Step 5

2

OUTPUT VOLTAGE CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check that the signal output voltage for the slewing sensor (lateral acceleration signal) is between 0.3 and 4.7 V

See E7023 ESP

See Test 3350EC SIDE ACCELERATION/YAW SENSOR CHECK

Move on to Step 4

Voltage outside of range

Move on to Step 3

4

VEHICLE GEOMETRY CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Move on to Step 5

Move on to Step 5

5

CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Delete the errors using the diagnostic equipment.

Carry out the road test

to ensure that the control unit checks whether there are any errors still present.

Return to the workshop and check that the fault is no longer present using the diagnostic equipment
